description: REQ-VAL-022 (R-1018): 2×10⁴ random z uniform in the ball ‖z‖ < 4, decoded, canonicalised and encoded under the defaults links at f64: ‖z − E(D(z))‖, z_β's difference on the circle, and the CoM of C(D(z)) within 1.7×10⁻¹⁶ of the origin; with RQ-475's families, 2000 equal-mass equilateral and 2000 collinear states through random gauge elements, and the same 2000 collinear states kept on the x-axis (the members judged bit for bit): max |w − w_in| (w_in the input's own orientation) and max |w| on C(x) within REQ-VAL-121's proposed bounds; every collinear state's angle at 0 or π̂, its z_β bit for bit where its C(x) has λ̃_y exactly ±0 and |λ̃_y| within the proposed collinear tolerance elsewhere; no state's lookup_clamped bit set by β; D(E(x))'s |w| reported.
